title: Jazzy Crunchy Welsh Borlotti Beans Hash
description: A delicious and kid-friendly breakfast dish from Wales, featuring garlicky borlotti beans, crunchy vegetables, and a zesty beurre-monte sauce.
instructions: Heat a large non-stick pan over medium heat and add the carrots and zucchinis.
Cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are tender and lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
Add the borlotti beans to the pan and stir to combine with the vegetables.
Make a small well in the center of the pan and crack in the eggs.
Scramble the eggs until they are cooked through, then stir them into the bean and vegetable mixture.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
To make the beurre-monte sauce, whisk together the mayonnaise and lemon juice in a small bowl until smooth.
Stir the beurre-monte sauce into the bean and egg mixture and cook for a further 1-2 minutes, until heated through.
Serve the hash hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley and additional beurre-monte sauce on the side, if desired.
